scope_note: Nineteen curated cross-check entries against selected CBI reference pages. A related entry is an archival candidate, not an exact image/object match. This is not an exhaustive audit of every CBI page, embedded photo, article or artifact. No CBI-hosted media is fetched or reused.
scope_note_zh: 围绕部分 CBI 参考页整理的 19 条人工交叉核查记录。相关候选不等于同图、同物；并非对 CBI 全站及全部内嵌照片、文章、器物的穷尽核验。未抓取或复用 CBI 托管媒体。

records.archival_title: A Chinese soldier guards a line of American P-40 fighter planes
records.evidence: The official NARA gallery identifies shark-mouth P-40s of the Flying Tigers in China, circa 1942. The CBI reference concerns the same unit; no identical CBI photograph has been established.
records.evidence_zh: NARA 官方图集确认这是约 1942 年在中国的飞虎队 P-40 战斗机照片；与 CBI 页同属飞虎队主题，尚未确认同图。
records.rights_note: NARA states the photographs selected for this official gallery are in the public domain and have no use restrictions. Credit National Archives and the item/local identifier.
records.next_step: Use the NARA record and caption in the demo; compare photographer, date and image composition before claiming the CBI reference uses this exact photograph.
records.next_step_zh: 演示使用 NARA 记录及说明；核对摄影者、日期与画面构图后，才能声称与 CBI 参考页是同一张照片。
records.access_note: Official NARA gallery and image accessible; catalogue requires JavaScript.

records.archival_title: U.S.-built Army trucks on a mountain supply road (original caption: Ledo supply road)
records.evidence: NARA lists this transport photograph with local identifier 208-AA-45L-1 under its historical Ledo-road caption. This is a related logistics image, not a proven exact CBI match; the original location caption still needs geographic review.
records.evidence_zh: NARA 以 208-AA-45L-1 及历史上的雷多公路说明收录此运输照片。它是相关后勤素材，尚非 CBI 同图；原始地点说明仍需地理核实。
records.rights_note: NARA states the selected photographs in this gallery are public domain. Original captions are historical metadata, not independently verified geography.
records.next_step: Use the NARA record and caption in the demo; compare photographer, date and image composition before claiming the CBI reference uses this exact photograph.
records.next_step_zh: 演示使用 NARA 记录及说明；核对摄影者、日期与画面构图后，才能声称与 CBI 参考页是同一张照片。
records.access_note: Official NARA gallery and image accessible; catalogue requires JavaScript.

records.archival_title: American and Chinese soldiers place allied flags on a jeep before the first convoy to China
records.evidence: NARA identifies a photograph by Sgt. John Gutman dated 6 February 1945, connected with the Ledo-to-Kunming convoy. It corroborates the event referenced by the CBI page without establishing that its reproduction is this image.
records.evidence_zh: NARA 标注摄影者 John Gutman 及日期 1945 年 2 月 6 日，内容与雷多至昆明首批车队有关；可互证事件，尚不能证明是 CBI 页所用照片。
records.rights_note: NARA states the selected photographs in this gallery are public domain; cite NAID 535573 and 208-AA-338A-1.
records.next_step: Use the NARA record and caption in the demo; compare photographer, date and image composition before claiming the CBI reference uses this exact photograph.
records.next_step_zh: 演示使用 NARA 记录及说明；核对摄影者、日期与画面构图后，才能声称与 CBI 参考页是同一张照片。
records.access_note: Official NARA gallery and image accessible; catalogue requires JavaScript.

records.archival_title: Troops in Burma read the proclamation of victory in Europe
records.evidence: NARA dates S/Sgt. Yarnell’s photograph to 9 May 1945 in Burma. It offers a CBI perspective on VE Day; it is not established as the photograph in the LIFE article referenced by the CBI site.
records.evidence_zh: NARA 将 Yarnell 摄于缅甸的照片标为 1945 年 5 月 9 日，可展示中缅印战区对欧战胜利的反应；并未确认是 CBI 所转载 LIFE 文章中的照片。
records.rights_note: NARA states the selected photographs in this gallery are public domain; cite NAID 531341 and 111-SC-262229.
records.next_step: Use the NARA record and caption in the demo; compare photographer, date and image composition before claiming the CBI reference uses this exact photograph.
records.next_step_zh: 演示使用 NARA 记录及说明；核对摄影者、日期与画面构图后，才能声称与 CBI 参考页是同一张照片。
records.access_note: Official NARA gallery and image accessible; catalogue requires JavaScript.

records.evidence: The CBI transcription and IA catalogue identify the Army Service Forces guide. IA dates its scan to 1943, credits the Special Service Division, and lists the same chapter sequence. This verifies the work, not the same physical copy.
records.evidence_zh: CBI 转录与 IA 目录均指向陆军勤务部指南；IA 标为 1943 年，署名特别勤务处，章节顺序相合。确认同一作品，未确认同一本实物或完全相同版次。
records.rights_note: Internet Archive item metadata displays Public Domain Mark 1.0; digitization credited to Southern Methodist University. Retain item attribution.
records.next_step: Compare imprint and page count before treating the digital scan as the identical edition.
records.next_step_zh: 核对版权页、印记及页数后，再确认是否完全同版。
records.access_note: IA metadata, PDF download listing and preview image accessible without credentials.

records.evidence: Both records identify the Army Service Forces Burma pocket guide. IA dates it to 1943 and lists chapters on Burmese customs, health and vocabulary matching the CBI transcription. No physical-copy identity is claimed.
records.evidence_zh: 两端均为陆军勤务部缅甸袖珍指南；IA 标为 1943 年，习俗、健康与词汇等章节与 CBI 转录对应。未认定为同一本实物。
records.rights_note: Internet Archive item metadata displays Public Domain Mark 1.0; the scan is credited to Google. Retain item attribution.
records.next_step: Compare edition statement, illustrations and pagination for an edition-level match.
records.next_step_zh: 对照版次、插图和分页，完成版本层级核验。
records.access_note: IA metadata, PDF download listing and preview image accessible without credentials.

records.evidence: LoC describes the guide as a 1944 edition of a work first issued in 1943. Its digitized title page says revised April 1944; the CBI page credits the earlier Special Service Division. Same work is supported; edition identity is unresolved.
records.evidence_zh: LoC 收录 1944 年版本，并说明初版于 1943 年；扫描标题页标为 1944 年 4 月修订版，CBI 则署名早期特别勤务处。可认定同一作品，不能直接认定同版。
records.rights_note: LoC’s digitized-book record states the books in this collection are public domain and free to use and reuse; credit Library of Congress.
records.next_step: Compare the CBI source imprint with the April 1944 revised edition before merging editions.
records.next_step_zh: 与 1944 年 4 月修订版核对 CBI 原件印记后，再合并版本。
records.access_note: Digitized-book resource list and indexed metadata accessible; direct item fetch returned HTTP 403 during this check.

records.archival_title: Mileage chart for the China-Burma-India theater of war
records.evidence: The LoC resource identifies an actual CBI mileage chart in the Charles E. Kavenagh Collection. It is a candidate for the map theme, not a demonstrated match to a map on the CBI reference page.
records.evidence_zh: LoC 明确记录 Charles E. Kavenagh 藏集中的中缅印战区里程图，是地图主题的可用线索；尚未与 CBI 参考页任何地图建立同图关系。
records.rights_note: Veterans History Project contributors may retain copyright; check item and VHP publication/exhibition guidance before reproducing.
records.next_step: Compare map title, sheet number, scale and edition; retain the collection/resource identifier.
records.next_step_zh: 核对图名、图幅号、比例尺与版次，并保留藏集和资源编号。
records.access_note: Official indexed resource metadata and image-viewer link available; no map image reused here.

records.evidence: LoC records Graham’s service with the 5307th Composite Unit (Merrill’s Marauders) and 475th Infantry and provides a digitized personal collection. It adds a personal perspective to the CBI military-history theme; it is not a matching memoir.
records.evidence_zh: LoC 记载 Graham 曾在麦支队和第 475 步兵团服役，并提供个人藏集数字页面；可补充个人视角，未声称与 CBI 页回忆录相同。
records.rights_note: VHP donors may retain copyright. Consult the item and VHP guidance before republication.
records.next_step: Select a specific diary/photo page, identify creator and date, and clear exhibition reuse as needed.
records.next_step_zh: 选定具体日记或照片页，核对作者和日期，再核实展览使用条件。
records.access_note: Official indexed metadata confirms collection and unit affiliation; item sequence contains hundreds of images.

records.evidence: The LoC service note explicitly identifies Gray as a C-47 pilot who flew the Hump from India to China. This is related firsthand testimony, not evidence that the CBI Aluminum Trail page reproduces this collection.
records.evidence_zh: LoC 服役说明明确写明 Gray 驾驶 C-47 飞越印度至中国的驼峰航线；这是相关亲历资料，并不证明 CBI 的 Aluminum Trail 页面使用了此藏集。
records.rights_note: VHP contributors retain any copyright they hold; educational availability is not a blanket reuse licence.
records.next_step: Check recording/transcript availability and select a timestamped passage before quoting.
records.next_step_zh: 核实录音与转录稿可用性，引用前选定带时间戳的段落。
records.access_note: Official search-indexed metadata verified; direct item request returned HTTP 403 in this environment.

records.evidence: The National Museum of American History catalogues a cotton blood chit credited to Col. Robley E. Winfrey. The shared object type supports a comparison, but no serial-number or provenance link to a CBI-page specimen is established.
records.evidence_zh: 美国国家历史博物馆收录一件棉布血幅，编号 1991.0840.007；器物类型相同，可作比较，但尚无序号或来源证据证明与 CBI 页某件实物相同。
records.rights_note: The Smithsonian record explicitly says Usage Conditions Apply. No image is embedded in this demo entry.
records.next_step: Compare printed languages, serial number, dimensions and provenance; request an image licence if required.
records.next_step_zh: 对照文字语言、序号、尺寸与来源；若需要，再申请图片许可。
records.access_note: Official indexed collection metadata verified; direct page fetch returned HTTP 520 during this check.

records.evidence: The museum describes a blue circular Fourteenth Air Force patch and distinguishes that 1943 unit from the original American Volunteer Group. It is a related insignia, not a verified AVG object or a proven CBI-page match.
records.evidence_zh: 博物馆将其识别为第十四航空队蓝色圆形臂章，并区分 1943 年成立的该队与早期美国志愿航空队。它是相关徽章，未认定为 AVG 原件或 CBI 页同物。
records.rights_note: Smithsonian image use is marked Usage Conditions Apply. The record link is retained without image reuse.
records.next_step: Keep AVG and Fourteenth Air Force labels distinct; verify accession/provenance before assigning an exact match.
records.next_step_zh: 区分 AVG 与第十四航空队，核对登记号及来源后再确定是否同物。
records.access_note: Official indexed collection page supplies the description; direct canonical page was not rendered by the retrieval tool.

records.evidence: The museum article identifies Flying Tigers’ wooden P-40 decoys and cites archival photograph SI 90-13683. This supplies an attributed research lead; no claim is made that the CBI page uses the same photograph or article.
records.evidence_zh: 博物馆文章介绍飞虎队木制 P-40 诱饵机，并列出档案照片号 SI 90-13683；这是有来源的研究线索，未认定为 CBI 同图或同文。
records.rights_note: Article and image reuse rights are not established in the retrieved excerpt; link only.
records.next_step: Resolve SI 90-13683 to the archival image record and its rights statement before using a preview.
records.next_step_zh: 先将 SI 90-13683 对应到档案图片记录并核查使用条件，再显示预览。
records.access_note: Official search-indexed article and photo identifier verified; direct fetch returned HTTP 403.

records.archival_title: Office of Strategic Services Blood Chit
records.source_name_zh: 美国中央情报局博物馆
records.evidence: The official museum page identifies this silk rescue notice as issued for OSS use in the CBI Theater, with dimensions 20 by 21 cm. No museum accession number or CBI-reference specimen identity was exposed.
records.evidence_zh: CIA 博物馆说明这件 20×21 厘米丝质求救血幅供 OSS 在中缅印战区使用；页面未提供馆藏登记号，也未与 CBI 参考页具体实物建立同物关系。
records.rights_note: No item-specific media licence was established from the record; metadata and outbound link only.
records.next_step: Check museum media terms and compare the printed text/design and provenance before any image reuse.
records.next_step_zh: 核查博物馆媒体使用条款，并对照文字、图案和来源后，再考虑使用图片。
records.access_note: Official public artifact description accessible without credentials.

records.archival_id: Film number USA 14; IWM film record 2992
records.evidence: IWM catalogues the American wartime film centred on building the Ledo/Stilwell Road and supplying China. It complements the CBI road pages; it is not the same work as the separately titled Ledo Lifeline booklet.
records.evidence_zh: IWM 收录以修筑雷多／史迪威公路和援华运输为主题的美国战时影片；可补充 CBI 公路页面，不应与 Ledo Lifeline 小册子合并为同一作品。
records.rights_note: IWM film access and licensing conditions apply; no video or still image copied.
records.next_step: Use IWM’s film reference to request/verify a playable copy and clip licence for a public presentation.
records.next_step_zh: 使用 IWM 影片编号核查可播放副本及公开演示片段许可。
records.access_note: Official catalogue accessible; IWM marks this copy Digitised: No and Media not currently available. No playable copy is claimed.

records.archival_id: Film number GEN 16; IWM film record 503
records.evidence: IWM’s July 1945 newsreel description includes a Dakota flying over the Himalayas, supplies at Kunming, and refugee children returning to India. This corroborates the Hump theme; no exact relationship to the CBI article is asserted.
records.evidence_zh: IWM 对 1945 年 7 月新闻片的说明包括 Dakota 飞越喜马拉雅、昆明卸货及儿童返印；与驼峰主题相关，未认定与 CBI 文章有直接同源关系。
records.rights_note: IWM catalogue attribution is © IWM. Streaming availability does not grant clipping or republication rights.
records.next_step: Verify the relevant reel and timestamps; obtain the applicable clip permission if included in a public demo.
records.next_step_zh: 核实相关片卷与时间点；若公开演示影片片段，再确认适用许可。
records.access_note: Official indexed film metadata lists digitized media and two HD reels.

records.archival_title: Control of theater newspaper "CBI Roundup" — attached issue dated January 11, 1945
records.archival_id: CARL p4013coll8/2298; call number N13669; Part 2, pages 14–19
records.source_name_en: Ike Skelton Combined Arms Research Library
records.source_name_zh: 艾克·斯凯尔顿联合兵种研究图书馆
records.evidence: CARL’s catalogue explicitly lists a sample CBI Roundup dated 11 January 1945 inside the control-of-newspaper file. The CBI transcription identifies volume III, number 18 on that date. This is an issue-level match supported by metadata; page-by-page scan comparison remains.
records.evidence_zh: CARL 目录明确说明该卷附有 1945 年 1 月 11 日 CBI Roundup 样报；CBI 转录标示同日第三卷第 18 期。元数据支持同一期作品，仍需逐页对照扫描件。
records.rights_note: CARL states Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited. Check any separately credited images before standalone image reuse.
records.next_step: Open the Part 2 PDF and compare masthead, page numbers and lead story to confirm the complete issue.
records.next_step_zh: 打开第二部分 PDF，核对报头、页码与头条，确认整期内容是否完整一致。
records.access_note: Official indexed catalogue metadata verified; direct viewer timed out during this check. No PDF fetched.

records.archival_title: Inside Wartime China published by the Chinese Ministry of Information, 1943
records.archival_id: Lowe Family Papers MS 0588; Box 4, Folder 12; archival object 92597
records.source_name_zh: 莱斯大学伍德森研究中心
records.evidence: Rice’s finding aid identifies the title, publisher and year. The CBI menu exposes the same title, but the CBI booklet imprint and digitized Rice copy were not inspected, so work/edition equivalence is still unverified.
records.evidence_zh: 莱斯大学检索目录提供同名册子的出版机关与年份；CBI 菜单虽同名，但未核对 CBI 版权页或莱斯藏本影像，因此作品／版本相同性仍待验证。
records.rights_note: The finding aid says open for research and stored off site; it provides no blanket reproduction licence or online scan.
records.next_step: Request catalogue/scan details from the repository after comparing the CBI imprint; do not imply online full-text access.
records.next_step_zh: 先核对 CBI 印记，再向馆方确认目录与扫描件信息；不可将目录开放说成全文在线。
records.access_note: Official search-indexed finding aid verified; no online full text established and no repository contact sent.

records.archival_title: La discussion des Trois Amis : le Pacifique ; offensive Rommel ; route de Birmanie ; Japonais à Java
records.source_name_zh: 欧洲数字文化遗产平台
records.evidence: The existing Europeana API snapshot identifies French INA audio with Burma Road in its title. This is a cross-language topical candidate; its date and playable recording have not been verified and it does not identify the LIFE article as the same work.
records.evidence_zh: 既有 Europeana API 快照标明这是标题涉及滇缅公路的法国 INA 音频。它是跨语言主题候选，日期与可播放内容尚未核实，不能认定与 LIFE 文章同文同源。
records.rights_note: Europeana metadata is CC0; the supplied media rights statement is In Copyright (InC 1.0). No media preview or audio copied.
records.next_step: Resolve the INA provider record, verify recording date and playback, and review media reuse permission.
records.next_step_zh: 解析 INA 原馆记录，核实录制日期和播放条件，再审查媒体使用许可。
records.access_note: Europeana API metadata was retrieved on 2026-10-10; this specific item/provider link was not rendered by the web retrieval tool today. Media access remains unverified.
